columns.name: ENTRY_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the entity associated with the entry.

columns.name: REFERENCE_AUX
columns.description: Auxiliary reference to the entity associated with the entry.

columns.name: CONTEXT
columns.description: Context where the content was generated.

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of content. JSON content is stored in CONTENT_JSON while non-JSON in CONTENT.

columns.name: CONTENT_JSON
columns.description: JSON content. The column configuration optimzes access to JSON content.

columns.name: CONTENT
columns.description: Non-JSON content. The type of the content is defined by CONTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
